==Objectives==
Report to Grand Magister Rommath. He can be found on the top of the Regency Tower.

==Description==
With the current situation in the [[Regency Council]], my hands are bound. No one but [[Lor'themar]] would believe me, even with the letter in our possession. They would undoubtedly perceive my actions as an attempt to usurp the title.

However, all is not lost. If you can convince Rommath that you are, indeed, a delegation from [[Felstrider Retreat]], he may inadvertently reveal more about his plans. The letter is exceedingly vague, and this approach may unveil additional details. Go, but exercise caution to avoid exposing your true identity. Rommath is unpredictable, and he could dispose of you in the blink of an eye.

He is on the top of the tower.

==Rewards==
You will receive:
*90 XP
*+150 [[reputation]] with [[Silvermoon Remnant]]

==Progress==
Who dares interrupt my meditation?

==Completion==
Ah, you are from Felstrider, correct? You are safe; no one can hear us.

<Rommath scrutinizes you, studying your face for an extended moment.>

Very well. I have made all the necessary preparations. If my calculations are correct—and they are—we should be able to establish contact with Prince Kael'Thas.

By the way, is everything well with [[Eldin]]? That fool [[Astalor]] has been attempting to amass a force to attack Felstrider, but he has been unsuccessful, as usual.

Good, good. Inform me when you are ready.
